subject: Consolidating vendor pay cycles and invoice routing for Q3 onboarding
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Russo <elena.russo@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidating vendor pay cycles and invoice routing for Q3 onboarding

Hi Elena —

Quick note as we kick off Solstice Health's onboarding: procurement is asking us to standardize the invoice routing and net terms for the vendor cohort we're activating in Q3. Right now we see variability in how invoices arrive and in requested terms (Net30 / Net45 / Net60), which complicates PO mapping and month-end close.

Would Solstice consider aligning to Net45 for this set of contracts as the default? Net45 helps us align with our monthly close cadence while still giving vendors reasonably fast payment. Two follow-ups from our side if that works for you: 

- Route all invoices to ap@redwood.com and include the Redwood PO in the email subject (PO-#####).
- Use the attached onboarding form and fill PO number + remit details on page 2 (I attached a filled PO_template_v2.xlsx we prefer).

If you need to keep Net30 for billing reasons, we can offer an early-pay enrollment (1% fee) for Net30 -> paid-in-7 option on a small pilot.

Attached: redwood_onboarding_form.pdf, PO_template_v2.xlsx

Would you be available for a 30-minute call next week to confirm routing and any exceptions (e.g., clinical supplies)? If yes, Kimberly and Marissa will join.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Vendor Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0103

--
From: Elena Russo <elena.russo@solsticehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@solsticehealth.com
Date: 2028-05-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating vendor pay cycles and invoice routing for Q3 onboarding

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the note and the attachments. We prefer Net30 as our standard, but we can be flexible for strategic partners. A few quick items from our side: 

- Our AP mailbox (accounts-payable@solsticehealth.com) is monitored by a small team; routing to ap@redwood.com is fine so long as the remittance email includes the vendor tax ID and the PO in the subject.
- Attached our supplier_setup form (solstice_supplier_setup.pdf) — it asks for ACH details and a preferred remittance contact.
- On early-pay: we could do a 0.75% fee for payment within 10 days; need finance sign-off.

I can join a sync next week, Wed/Thu morning PT work best. Adding our AP manager (Carlos Mendes) in the thread when we confirm.

Best,
Elena Russo
Head of Procurement, Solstice Health
elena.russo@solsticehealth.com

Subject: Re: Consolidating vendor pay cycles and invoice routing for Q3 onboarding

Logan / Kim —

Thanks Elena for the quick reply. Based on previous vendor rollouts I've done, here's a suggested mapping and a short mutual action plan so this doesn't slow activation: 

Suggested mapping (we'll load into vendor portal):
- email_to: ap@redwood.com -> Invoice intake queue A (PO matching)
- subject_prefix: PO-##### (required)
- remit_id: vendor_tax_id -> required field (for payments team)
- payment_terms_field: "requested_terms" -> accepts Net30/45/60; we will auto-map Net30 to "early-pay candidate" tag for pilot ops

Mutual action plan: 
1) Solstice returns solstice_supplier_setup.pdf + ACH details (Elena/AP) — due 5/22
2) Redwood returns vendor portal test record and assigned PO template (Marissa) — due 5/24
3) Finance to approve 0.75% early-pay vs. Redwood's recommended 1% (Kimberly + Logan) — decision by 5/25
4) 30-minute sync to confirm exceptions and clinical supplies routing (All) — propose 5/26 10:00 PT

HubSpot reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-9876 (tracking onboarding and invoice terms)

I'll prepare a short CSV for bulk vendor import once we lock the mapping. Logan — happy to own the import if you want me to run it.

-Marissa
Senior Procurement Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Elena / team —

Appreciate the flexibility. Confirming next steps and decisions from Redwood: 

- Redwood will accept Net30 or Net45. For this onboarding cohort, we will default to Net45 to align with our close cycle. Solstice can opt into Net30 with an early-pay enrollment.
- Finance sign-off: Kimberly, please evaluate the trade-off between 0.75% (Solstice offer) and our recommended 1% for Net30->paid-in-7. If finance prefers 0.75% we will adopt that for a 60-vendor pilot; if not, we'll keep 1% as our pilot threshold.
- Marissa will generate the vendor CSV and run the portal test record by 5/24.
- Elena, please return the completed solstice_supplier_setup.pdf and indicate preferred ACH remittance contact by 5/22.

Proposed sync: 2028-05-26 10:00 PT (30 minutes) — tentative; I'll send a calendar invite once we have confirmation.

Thanks all — moving this to operationalize so it doesn't delay go-live.

Logan Wright
Vendor Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
